name: Proposals for decisions
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union Agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how 31 European Union agencies spent their 2023 budgets and closes their accounts. It also lists problems found by the European Court of Auditors, mainly in public procurement, late payments and high carryovers of unspent money. It asks agencies to fix these weaknesses, improve transparency and gender balance, and report back. For the European Union Agency for Asylum, Parliament postpones its decision because of a fraud office report.

- Parliament grants or postpones budget discharge for each agency and closes their 2023 accounts.
- Agencies must fix procurement errors, late payments and carryovers, and report progress.
- The Asylum Agency's discharge is postponed until concerns about its management are answered.
